summary: Phase 1 — Modalidad de Registro (parejas foundation) backend tests: 12/12 PASS on the new test file + 164/164 PASS on existing regression suites (logic_modules, phase_a_elastico, phase_b_qr, phase_c_realtime, phase_c_supplement, phase_abd_http). Defaults, parejas_libres, parejas_mixtas, PUT round-trip, coherence validator (silently flips permitir_individual_en_parejas to False when modalidad='individual' on both POST and PUT), 422 on invalid/empty enums, and Inscripcion model defaults (pareja_grupo_id/nombre/telefono=None, es_free_agent=False) all verified end-to-end via the public preview URL. Created test retas cleaned up via DELETE in the fixture teardown — 0 leftovers in DB after run.
critical_code_review_comments: models.py:99 — `_coherencia_modalidad` mutates a frozen-style validated model via `object.__setattr__`. Works correctly today because Pydantic v2 BaseModel is mutable by default, but if `model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)` is ever added, this will silently no-op. Consider returning a copy or assigning normally (`self.permitir_individual_en_parejas = False`) for clarity.

models.py:Inscripcion — `pareja_grupo_id` non-null and `es_free_agent=True` are described as 'mutually exclusive' in the comment but no validator enforces it. Should be enforced in Phase 2 when InscripcionCreate is touched.

routers/retas.py:124 update_reta — re-uses `RetaCreate` body; if a client PUTs without `modalidad_registro` it defaults to 'individual' silently overwriting a parejas_libres reta. Not a bug per spec (PUT is full replace), but worth noting for the admin UI.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Test fixture creates 5-7 TEST_ retas during run and DELETEs all of them in module teardown. Verified 0 TEST_ leftovers in DB post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 'Modalidad de Registro' is GREEN. Next phases (per code comments): Phase 2 will modify InscripcionCreate to accept pareja_grupo_id/nombre/telefono/es_free_agent + add the public checkout flow for parejas. Phase 4 will add the free-agents bolsa endpoints. When those land, extend /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_modalidad_registro.py with new test classes (pattern is already established). Public inscription endpoint is POST /api/public/retas/{reta_id}/checkout (uses reta_id, not slug). Admin login = POST /api/auth/login with {username,password} (NOT email key).
